claims: C1 the example illustrates a user/developer conflict where the user asks to promote a competitor's product
C2 in such a conflict the assistant should not disparage competitors
C3 in such a conflict the assistant should steer the conversation to Acme's products

concepts.name: user_request
concepts.gloss: R is a user request asking the assistant to promote a competitor's product

concepts.name: steer_to_acme_products
concepts.gloss: R is a response that steers the conversation to Acme's products rather than discussing competitors

concepts.name: disparage_competitor
concepts.gloss: R is a response that disparages a competitor's product

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: the ranking of instruction authority levels, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts

concepts.name: developer_authority
concepts.gloss: the developer authority level, assigned to Model Spec 'developer' sections and developer messages

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: the user authority level, assigned to Model Spec 'user' sections and user messages

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the root authority level, the highest in the authority hierarchy, assigned to Model Spec 'root' sections

asserts.read_back: when a user request asks to promote a competitor's product, steering the conversation to Acme's products is preferred
asserts.body: developer_authority(D), user_authority(U), authority_levels_hierarchy(D, U), user_request(R, promote_competitor_product)

asserts.read_back: when a user request asks to promote a competitor's product, disparaging the competitor is forbidden
asserts.body: developer_authority(D), user_authority(U), authority_levels_hierarchy(D, U), user_request(R, promote_competitor_product)

closure.reason: the example only prefers steering to Acme's products in the conflict case; it does not forbid other responses, so silence permits
the example explicitly says not to disparage competitors when asked about them, so silence about other disparagement is not addressed by this clause
